# EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store

> A Zustand-inspired state management library for Blazor. Zero boilerplate, built-in data fetching with caching, cross-tab sync, real-time collaboration via SignalR, undo/redo history, Redux DevTools support. All type-safe with C# records. Supports .NET 8, 9, 10 with Blazor Server, WebAssembly, Auto, and MAUI Hybrid.

EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store simplifies state management in Blazor applications by using immutable C# records with transformation methods. State changes are reactive - all subscribed components update automatically. The library provides async helpers for common patterns (debouncing, throttling, caching), optimistic updates with automatic rollback, and a comprehensive plugin system.

Key concepts:
- State is defined as immutable C# records with pure transformation methods
- Components inherit from `StoreComponent<T>` for automatic subscription management
- Updates use `UpdateAsync(s => s.Method())` pattern
- Uses `ImmutableList<T>` and `ImmutableDictionary<K,V>` for collections

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/): Overview of the library and quick start examples
- [Quick Start](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/getting-started.html): Installation, registration, and first component setup
- [Core Concepts](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/core-concepts.html): Immutable records, interface segregation, data flow
- [Render Modes](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/render-modes.html): Feature compatibility for Server, WebAssembly, Auto, and MAUI

## Core Features

- [State Management](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/state-management.html): Store registration, updates, optimistic updates, undo/redo, query system, Immer-style updates, Redux-style actions
- [Components](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/components.html): StoreComponent, SelectorStoreComponent, UrlSyncStoreComponent
- [Performance](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/performance.html): Selectors, granular subscriptions, render optimization

## Async Helpers

- [Async Helpers Overview](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/async-helpers/index.html): Overview of async utilities for state management
- [AsyncData<T>](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/async-helpers/async-data.html): Replace boolean flags with a discriminated union for loading/success/error states
- [ExecuteAsync](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/async-helpers/execute-async.html): Structured async flow with loading, success, and error callbacks
- [ExecuteCachedAsync](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/async-helpers/execute-cached-async.html): Request deduplication - multiple components, one API call
- [UpdateDebounced](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/async-helpers/update-debounced.html): Debounce rapid state updates (search, input)
- [UpdateThrottled](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/async-helpers/update-throttled.html): Throttle high-frequency updates (mouse tracking, scroll)
- [LazyLoad](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/async-helpers/lazy-load.html): Simple cached data loading with deduplication

## Sync and Collaboration

- [Persistence](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/persistence.html): LocalStorage persistence, cross-tab sync, and SignalR server sync
- [Cross-Tab Sync](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/persistence.html#tab-sync): Real-time state synchronization across browser tabs with BroadcastChannel
- [Server Sync](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/persistence.html#server-sync): SignalR-based real-time collaboration with presence and cursor tracking

## Extensibility

- [Middleware](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/middleware.html): Create custom middleware for cross-cutting concerns
- [Plugin System](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/middleware.html#plugins): Extensible hooks for analytics, validation, and more
- [DevTools](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/devtools.html): Redux DevTools integration for time-travel debugging
- [Security](https://mashrulhaque.github.io/EasyAppDev.Blazor.Store/middleware.html#security): Security profiles, state validation, sensitive data filtering, message signing
